call: Hello, this is nuuEnergy’s assistant. We’ll check, for free, whether a heat pump suits your home. nuuEnergy never asks for bank details or passwords.
Built in 1987, thank you. About how many square metres do you heat?
What do you heat with today?
Heating oil, about 2,500 litres a year.
That’s about 25,000 kilowatt hours. Are your rooms heated with radiators or underfloor heating?
Radiators. I think it is a single-pipe system.
A single-pipe system needs a technician’s closer look, but it doesn’t rule out a heat pump.
Your result is yellow. Estimated running costs are 2,043 euros a year, versus 4,250 euros for oil.
